what_it_is.prose:
Hyderabad-based drone battery-pack company (Li-ion, Li-HV, semi-solid-state packs, BMS, chargers). Company states it designs, manufactures and services packs; cell origin undisclosed. Drone Expo 2026 exhibitor.

Value-chain position in the Atlas: Develops → Drone battery packs (L3); Depends on → High-energy Li-ion cells (L3).

Evidence discipline: this record separates company claims from independent evidence. Classifications above carry their evidence level; the technology-origin class is 'UNKNOWN'. Exhibiting at Drone Expo 2026 establishes market presence only — not indigenous technology, Indian manufacturing, procurement or deployment.
